decision_conditions: The proposed roof-mounted Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) by reason of its siting and form, would introduce an alien feature. This alien feature would be out of keeping with the character of the host building and its simplistically designed roof.  The proposal is therefore contrary to the NPPF (2026), Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies  DMD 6, DMD 8 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposal would result in the loss of private, usable and secure outdoor amenity space serving the residential unit. As a consequence, the development would provide a substandard living environment as it would fail to secure and cater for the reasonable external amenity needs of future occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to the NPPF (2026), Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD 6, DMD8 and DMD 9 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and the London Housing SPG.
